market.question: MicroStrategy (Strategy) sells any Bitcoin by May 31, 2026?
market.resolutionText:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if MicroStrategy sells any of its Bitcoin by 11:59 PM ET on the date specified in the title. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from MSTR and on-chain data, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

label.marketTitle: MicroStrategy (Strategy) sells any Bitcoin by May 31, 2026?
label.whatHappened: A Strategy 8-K filed June 1, 2026 disclosed 32 BTC sold between May 26-31 (first disposal since 2022). Two proposed NO resolutions were challenged, sending it to a UMA token vote. UMA voters ruled the May 31 contract NO (and the June 30 contract YES), deciding only the June 1 public-disclosure date counted, not the actual May sale date. Galaxy Research objected that a 'plain reading' should have resolved YES; ~$14M+ was in dispute across the linked contracts.
